mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit.audit_logs ( actor_id, actor_name, actor_roles, actor_ip, action, entity_type, entity_id, entity_number, occurred_at, http_method, endpoint, request_id, is_success, error_code, old_value, new_value, description, service_name ) VALUES ( #{entity.actorId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.eprocure.admin.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{entity.actorName}, COALESCE(string_to_array(NULLIF(#{entity.actorRolesText}, ''), ','), ARRAY[]::VARCHAR[]), CAST(#{entity.actorIp,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS INET), #{entity.action}, #{entity.entityType}, #{entity.entityId,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.eprocure.admin.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{entity.entityNumber}, #{entity.occurredAt}, #{entity.httpMethod}, #{entity.endpoint}, #{entity.requestId}, #{entity.success}, #{entity.errorCode}, CAST(#{entity.oldValueJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), CAST(#{entity.newValueJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB), #{entity.description}, #{entity.serviceName} )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, actor_id, actor_name, array_to_string(actor_roles, ',') AS actor_roles_text, actor_ip::TEXT AS actor_ip, action, entity_type, entity_id, entity_number, occurred_at, http_method, endpoint, request_id, is_success, error_code, old_value::TEXT AS old_value_json, new_value::TEXT AS new_value_json, description, service_name, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count FROM audit.audit_logs
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{filter.size} OFFSET #{filter.offset}
